functionalReqs: Serve multiple models and versions behind one API
hints: Why is LLM decoding memory-bandwidth bound, and what does batching do about it?
Look at continuous batching, KV-cache memory management (paging), and splitting prefill from decode.

Gateway (auth, quotas) → scheduler/router (model-aware, prefix-cache-aware, priority queues) → model servers (tensor parallel across GPUs, continuous batching, paged KV cache, quantised weights, speculative decoding) → autoscaling on queue depth and KV utilisation; prefill/decode disaggregation for long prompts; offline batch queue fills idle capacity; canary per model version.
nonFunctionalReqs: TTFT and inter-token latency SLOs per tier
Isolation: one team's spike doesn't break another's SLO
problemStatement: Design an internal **LLM inference platform** that serves several models (7B to 400B parameters) to many product teams through one API, maximising GPU utilisation while meeting latency SLOs.
